events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Enduring Wit
angles.copy: From the Pythons to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us decades of iconic comedy. Celebrating his 87th today, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the iconic 'White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries – what track still stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman and legendary performer Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth UK studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 59 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, showcasing a new depth in their songwriting. Still sounds fresh today!

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a visionary artist whose music continues to inspire generations. His legacy lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Bowie
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the incredible life and artistry of David Bowie. A true icon, forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. The King's influence is still felt today.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock history. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod The Mod's Day
angles.copy: Happy 82nd to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to solo superstardom, his voice is unmistakable. What's your go-to Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs, the inimitable voice of Madness! Still bringing the house down after decades. What's your favourite nutty tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, famous for his blue-eyed soul hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young's Soulful Day
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! His smooth vocals defined an era. What's the Paul Young track that takes you back?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating Dolly's Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we celebrate the incredible life and enduring spirit of Dolly Parton. A true national treasure.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and record producer Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband hits to solo success, what's your favourite Gary-penned tune?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for global hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Smooth Grooves
angles.copy: Happy 77th to the legendary Billy Ocean! His smooth voice has given us so many timeless hits. What's your favourite?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years since the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction! Who from that inaugural class still rocks your world?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, known for his solo work and contributions to the iconic boyband, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Always bringing the charm and the tunes. What's your favourite Mark moment?
